studies.label: CTpop -> Topp2000 Islet Parameterization — Beta-Cell Composition Shifts the Glucose Setpoint

nodes.label:
The one curated model that loaded in both engines (BIOMD0000000633,
Bulik2016...
nodes.statement:
The one curated model that loaded in both engines (BIOMD0000000633,
Bulik2016 hepatic glucose metabolism) shows near-perfect cross-engine
agreement (mean nRMSE 2.05e-07, bucket "Good"), independently
cross-validated by the committed full-corpus dataset's measurement of
the same model (1.61e-07, also "good") -- confirming COPASI and
Tellurium integrate this stiff hepatic-glucose ODE system to
numerically indistinguishable trajectories. The other 4/5 models fail
identically on a missing SED-ML file, a load-time gap rather than a
numerical disagreement.

nodes.label:
Binding the documented healthy islet composition (54% beta) to
Topp2000's ini...
nodes.statement:
Binding the documented healthy islet composition (54% beta) to
Topp2000's initial beta-cell mass reproduces the model's own default
(b_ref=37) and the model settles at its physiological fixed point
(glucose ~100 mg/dL over 4,000 model-days). Binding the documented
T2D-relevant beta-depleted composition (30% beta) scales the initial
mass down to ~20.56 and the identical model crosses Topp2000's
beta-cell-mass bifurcation into its pathological fixed point (glucose
~600 mg/dL, beta-cell mass and insulin collapsing toward 0) -- the
CTpop composition mechanistically shifts which of the model's two
stable regimes the glucose trajectory lands in, not merely its
numeric value.
